_doc: Sensor library for scan simulator v2 (SPEC section 4). Every number is {value, source}: source is a section-3 key or 'assumption: <reason>'. logit Pd = a[class] - k_depth * (depth_m - 0.05) / 0.10; beyond max_depth_m Pd = 0.

sources.DMZ21: Sensors 2021, drone magnetometer in the DMZ
sources.ITEP04: ITEP/US Army HSTAMIDS vs VMH-1, Thailand 2004
sources.DAN: Daniels, review of GPR for landmine detection
sources.GPRREV: Review of landmine detection using GPR
sources.DANUXO: Daniels, dual-sensor results in live minefields
sources.IRAT: SPIE 4394, IR signatures of surface and buried AT landmines
